rating.reasoning_summary: This strand is pure meta-commentary on Twitter engagement mechanics—specifically the social ritual of labeling high-performing tweets as 'bangers.' It lacks a boundary object beyond the word itself and shows zero conceptual evolution over nearly two years (2023-2025). The discourse remains static: people joke about posting bangers, reference the dopamine hit of virality, and occasionally attempt to game the algorithm with prompt injection memes. There is no dialectic, no knowledge production, and no real-world artifact. This is social grooming disguised as discourse—a recurring inside joke that reinforces in-group membership but produces nothing durable.

essential_tweets.annotation: Origin point: DanielleFong establishing 'banger' as casual slang for viral success
Gamification fantasy: proposing 'banger tokens' as algorithmic mechanic
Strategic insight: timing replies to viral tweets for engagement farming
Meme iteration: visual representation of post-banger dopamine hit
Community ritual: screenshot of replies all saying 'banger' as validation
Status anxiety: questioning whether paid verification undermines banger credibility
Application: labeling someone else's joke as 'Certified Banger™' (meta-commentary)
Ironic demand: 'post a banger' as proof of authenticity in political drama
Prompt injection meme: attempting to trick algorithm with explicit instructions
Pseudo-wisdom: claiming quantity leads to quality (no evidence, just vibes)
